verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents a hosted ready-to-use checkout (Checkout Pro) and a Checkout API with webhooks. It also supplies developer accelerators that plausibly support a fast integration: test users for validating payment flows, a Postman collection, an MCP server, and a Claude Code plugin claimed to build integrations 'in minutes'. However, the evidence never shows language-specific copy-paste code samples or SDKs, and nothing substantiates an end-to-end working flow from docs alone in under a day. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples in multiple programming languages/SDKs, a documented quickstart proving a working flow in under a day, and independent or hands-on corroboration of integration speed.
